author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: For FortiDeceptor's event log sent to the data collector by a remote log server of type Syslog Protocol (Log > Log Servers); the README has the steps. Decoy hits (regular, IPS, web filtering and port scan events) go to Thirdparty with the attacker as the source, the decoy as the destination, the ports, service, the account tried, the operation as the category and the event ID as the alert ID; the log level sets the severity, and the incident ID, decoy group and type, tag key, attack and category go to additional_data. The password the attacker tried isn't copied out. Administrator logins, logouts and session timeouts in the web console and CLI go to Auth with the address and interface; an action=Login line whose status isn't success counts as a failure. Other events an administrator caused go to ManagementEvent. FortiDeceptor's own events and its SNMP TRAP copies of decoy hits stay generic. Every FortiDeceptor line is type=event subtype=system, which the built-in Fortinet_Event claims and leaves with only sensor_type FORTIGATE_FW, so all three parsers are children of Fortinet_Event. To add each in Sophos Fusion, choose Add Custom Parser, tick Set Global Parent in Parser Script and keep Parent parser (default): the parent picker lists only your own parsers, never built-in ones. Paste the whole file, !PARENT line included; its !SCHEMA line sets the schema, whatever the dialog shows. Inferred, not shown by Fortinet: where the decoy fields of the 5.0 and later log reference sit on a syslog line (releases before 4.3 put them in msg; the parsers read either), the failed login text, and whether date and time are UTC (read as UTC, as FortiSandbox documents for the same header). The pairs are read with CEF(), because Sophos NG-SIEM's SPLIT_NAME_VALUES cuts a quoted value that holds " key=" text, such as msg="Service=SSH AttackerIp=...". Samples are made up from Fortinet's FortiDeceptor log reference, admin guide and FortiSIEM examples. Each parser passed Run Test under Fortinet_Event in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16: 148 of 148 fields matched the emulator, each parser took each of its lines in 15 of 15 runs and in 5 of 5 with FortiGate and FortiSandbox events between them, and none took another line.
